text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Urgh...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I finally... finished the run...!
—I can take this off now, right...?"
(Thud, thud...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! These ankle weights
were really heavy...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still... Orfe-san used to wear these back in the day, too...
If I see it through, it's bound to make me stronger...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —...Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The one I admired so much. Whenever she ran,
it was as if a golden light shone down... I was captivated."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run just like her, too...
As a star Umamusume, I want to wear that glamorous crown."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...The Triple Crown is off the table. But...
we've still got the Double Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Stepping up in distance won't be a problem at all.
To pass Ai-san, running up front is the only way...
I've built up the stamina to hold my top speed, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to properly demonstrate my power.
If I do that, I will win—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Haaaaaaaaaaaaa...!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...No, ya can't.
Don't go fillin' yer head with useless thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I'm gonna take the Double Tiara.

The day of the Oaks. At Almond Eye's request,
we entered the waiting room earlier than usual.
The reason was...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, stop right there.
Could you play it again from the beginning?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...As expected. Her breakout technique is brilliant too.
She slips past the girl in front without losing any momentum.

She was watching footage of the Oka Sho race...
And within it, she was paying particular
attention to Lucky Lilac's run.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, thank you.
Now my mental image training is perfect!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Is what I'd like to say for sure, but
I want to sort through my thoughts a bit more!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Between 1,600m and 2,400m,
things will unfold quite differently.

The biggest change this time is certainly the step up in distance.
Judging by the pre-race buzz, most of the audience
seems to be concerned about that as well—

text_block_list.name: Passenger A
text_block_list.text: Man, that Oka Sho was just insane. I'm definitely backing Almond Eye all the way!

text_block_list.name: Passenger B
text_block_list.text:
"That was truly shocking... But you know,
can she really deliver the same performance at 2,400 meters?"

text_block_list.name: Passenger B
text_block_list.text:
If Miss Lala can secure a good position and break away from there...
In other words, if she runs a calm, flawless race...!

text_block_list.name: Passenger B
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye is strong, but she's still growing! Anything could happen out there!
I understand how others see it. But having watched her training, I'm confident the distance increase won't be an issue—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I need to be careful with my pacing!
And my start timing, too...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, keeping in mind where Lala makes her move...
I need to properly keep her in my sights..."
choice_data_list: (Am I getting a bit too ahead of myself...?)

text_block_list.text:
The distance itself isn't a problem. But 2400m is long...
If she runs tense, she won't be able to unleash her full potential.
The exhaustion would be immense as well...
choice_data_list: (Just relax your shoulders a little more—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ai-chaaangh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yaho~, came to cheer you on!
...Whoopsie?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan, doesn't your face look kinda stiff?
Wait, can you even see me right now?
choice_data_list: I was tensing up a bit...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Then here's a good luck hug! ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Squeezing in all that Pandora-chan power~!
Ai-chan, become a super genius too~♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
Oh, Pandora-san...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah♡ Ai-chan, as cute as ever♪
My genius power is fully recharged!
choice_data_list: Ai, you think you can do it?
Ai, you think you can handle it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Of course! It's all memorized right here in my head!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No matter how the race unfolds, it won't be a problem.
All that's left... is to win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Lala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
!
...Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“......Thanks for the other day.
You completely bested me back then, but today—”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll be keeping a close eye on you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You've polished yourself to absolute perfection
in time for today's race, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat you as you are now, too.
—That's why I won't take my eyes off you!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh.
You...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: “—Come, let us run. Right now!!”
